contexts.text: Truth... cannot endure the first look of Divine good until it has entered into the bridegroom's chamber...
Love espouses wisdom to itself by preparing its house or chamber for it.

Love truly conjugial dwells in the highest region in the midst of mutual love, in the chamber or chamber of the will, and also in the midst of the perceptions of wisdom in the chamber or chamber of the understanding... I asked, Why are there two chambers? He said that the husband is in the chamber of the understanding, and the wife in the chamber of the will... Marriage cold also dwells in the highest region, but only in the chamber of the understanding, the chamber of the will there being closed.
A bridegroom cannot enter the chamber of a maiden not espoused to him...
He then leads her into the chamber...
Who enters into the chamber with the bride after the wedding until he has washed himself all over and dressed himself in a wedding garment?
From its right chamber the heart pours the blood into the lungs, and the lungs pour it back again into the left chamber of the heart.
